title: Causal verdict on sparse installed-base service threshold
objective: Determine whether the real service-density middle zone creates an independent missing edge or is already absorbed by authorized partner and white-label field-service institutions.
truth_rules: A REAL ECONOMIC THRESHOLD != AN OPEN CONTROL PLANE
FAST LOCAL HANDS WITHOUT PARTS/DOCUMENTATION/AUTHORIZATION != FAST RESTORATION

threshold_verdict.finding: Service density plausibly changes the efficient organizational form from remote/fly-in support to partner networks and eventually owned local service.

evidence.fact: Noch markets a white-label OEM field network including OEM-procedure training, warranty service, commissioning, corrective/preventive maintenance, documentation and escalation.
Quest provides white-label field execution for OEMs with installation, maintenance, upgrades, training and outcome-based SLAs.
Prohoc describes global OEM field-service mobilization for assembly, installation, commissioning, maintenance, repair and upgrades.

ASEAN Machine operates a China–Thailand industrial bridge with China-side and Thailand-side teams, factory audits, FAT, Thai SAT/commissioning, operator training, spare-parts kit, parts SLA and after-sales pipeline.

A current Thai recruitment page describes the China Machinery & Electronic Products (Thailand) Service Center as an online platform + offline showroom + local service team with Thai–Chinese pre/after-sales support.

china_asean_residual_test.interpretation: Bilingual contracting/local presence/training/commissioning/parts coordination can already be integrated by existing intermediaries.

competing_hypotheses.finding: Local multi-brand service firms and field networks already exist.
Training and certification are standard elements of authorized partner/white-label programs.
Existing China–Thailand bridges already integrate bilingual/local commercial and service functions.
A real middle zone exists conceptually and is supported by observed staged service-network organization.
Distributor/authorized-service/white-label network is the normal economic response to sparse local installed base.

governing_structure: foreign equipment sale creates installed-base service obligations
local-response pressure rises with installed base
owned service remains uneconomic at sparse density
authorized distributor/service partner/white-label field network absorbs the middle zone
OEM retains authority over model knowledge, warranty, parts and documentation

missing_edge.reason: The retained formation maps to existing institutional service-partner architecture. Geographic fragmentation alone does not establish an independent unowned control plane.

preserve_as: future vertical/geography-specific watch condition when direct uncovered installed-base evidence appears

meta_learning: A persistent economic threshold can be real without an open control plane when partner networks are the normal institutional form.
Fragmented coverage does not equal a structural missing edge.
Fast local hands without parts, documentation and authorization do not guarantee fast restoration.

requirements: prefer resources/capabilities stranded before a normal transaction already exists
reject structures naturally owned by distributor/platform/employer/property/service-network controllers
require repeated workaround or failed connection pressure
require routing to change feasible counterparties rather than merely select a partner
require recurring orchestration value beyond introduction
do not reopen generic ASEAN after-sales without a specific uncovered vertical-geography-installed-base cluster
